note: Layout recipes written for this project. They abstract recurring patterns seen in professional research decks into parameters of our own compositions and charts; no reference deck's text, artwork, marks or exact composition is reproduced. The design library (private) links its layout archetypes to these ids; the planner (TypeScript) and the agent tools (Python) both read this file.

recipes.name: Chart with a figures rail
recipes.when: One chart carries the message; one hero figure, at most two supporting figures and one short note say what it means.
rules: Action title: the conclusion in one sentence of 16 words or fewer, over the chart columns only.
The rail runs the full height beside the chart, tinted or dark, with a short heading naming what the figures mean.
One hero figure, then at most two supporting figures, each with a label that says what it measures and when.
Rail figures add a level, a change or a gap; the hero may restate the latest level as the focal figure, nothing else is repeated.
Footnote on the paper side, 8 pt, sources and definitions only.

recipes.name: Ranked bars with end values
recipes.when: One metric across many entities at one period, where the focus entity's rank is the message.
rules: Bars sorted by value; the focus bar in the structure colour on a tinted row, every other bar one quiet grey.
Values written at the bar ends; no axis, gridlines or legend.
Rank numerals at the left edge when the rank is the message.
A light panel behind the bars groups them as one exhibit.

recipes.name: Annotated trend with a shaded period
recipes.when: A metric over time for a focus entity against peers, where one period or one extreme carries the message.
rules: Series labelled at their ends with name and latest value; no legend.
The focus series heavy with every point marked; peers thin and quiet.
A light band marks the period the headline is about, labelled with the period only.
One callout at most, on the focus series' extreme, computed from the data.

recipes.name: Agenda with the current section marked
recipes.when: Opening a deck or a section: the sections in order, the one that follows highlighted.
rules: A paper column with the word Contents in the display face; the sections on navy.
Two-digit numerals in the display face; the current section in gold and bold, the others muted.
Section names of five words or fewer; no figures on navigation slides.

recipes.name: Section divider
recipes.when: Between sections of a deck of eight slides or more.
rules: Full navy slide; the section numeral in gold, the section title in the display face, one line saying what the section answers.
No photographs unless licensed for this deck; no figures.
